2609.35463.title: A.D.A.M.O. (Agent for language-Driven Actions with Multimodal Observations): A Visual-Symbolic Framework for Virtual Humans
2609.35463.paper_summary: Creating believable vh requires the coherent integration of perception, reasoning, and action mediated by language. A central challenge is to combine these components into a control loop grounded in interactive 3D environments. To this end, we present A.D.A.M.O. (Agent for language-Driven Actions with Multimodal Observations), a visual-symbolic framework for language-driven vh that leverages a pretrained vlm with tool calling to unify perception, reasoning, and action within a single control loop. A.D.A.M.O. maintains a dual visual-symbolic world model that combines egocentric visual input and synchronized symbolic state to support grounded task-oriented behavior from natural language prompts. To support diagnostic evaluation, we introduce a controlled task suite organized by a cd taxonomy that breaks down spatial tasks into procedural and linguistic complexity. Experiments in controlled scenes show that semantic labeling strongly influences task completion and failure modes, reducing perceptual ambiguity while shifting failures toward downstream execution, whereas reasoning errors remain comparatively rare.
2609.35463.paper_summary_zh: 創造可信的虛擬人需要感知、推理和行動的連貫整合，這一切都通過語言進行調解。 一個核心挑戰是將這些組件結合成一個基於互動3D環境的控制迴路。 為此，我們提出了A.D.A.M.O.（基於語言驅動行動的多模態觀察代理），這是一個視覺-符號框架，用於語言驅動的虛擬人，利用預訓練的視覺-語言模型和工具調用來統一感知、推理和行動於一個單一的控制迴路中。 A.D.A.M.O. 維持一個雙重的視覺-符號世界模型，結合自我中心的視覺輸入和同步的符號狀態，以支持從自然語言提示中衍生的有根據的任務導向行為。 為了支持診斷評估，我們引入了一套受控任務套件，按照一個分類法組織，將空間任務分解為程序性和語言複雜性。 在受控場景中的實驗顯示，語義標記對任務完成和失敗模式有強烈影響，減少了感知模糊性，同時將失敗轉向下游執行，而推理錯誤則相對罕見。
